description: VaN3Twin couples vehicle mobility and wireless communication to simulate ETSI-compliant vehicle-to-everything applications. The DriveX developers publish ns-3 modules linked to SUMO through TraCI, including ITS-G5, C-V2X mode 4 and NR-V2X support. Example applications cover vehicle communication, traffic management and emergency-vehicle warnings. Optional integrations add CARLA/OpenCDA and Sionna ray tracing. Users supply road maps, traffic traces and application settings; outputs describe simulated mobility and communication behaviour. The system has no fixed geographic coverage or observation period, and resolution follows the selected simulators. C++ source can be downloaded with installation documentation and free under GPL-2.0. Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04 and 24.04 are documented, with additional build settings for newer distributions. SUMO versions 1.6.0 through 1.18.0 are listed as tested; the developers explicitly do not guarantee compatibility with newer TraCI versions. The resource supports road-network communication and control experiments using ns-3 (platform-ns-3) and SUMO (model-sumo). It includes the former ms-van3t code under a new name; these are one resource, not separate additions. No coupled simulation was executed during this review.
